note: ⛔ SNG-482. Body's three authored gaps: an obscure, a bargain, and a soothe.

abilities.name: False Stance
abilities.narrationHints: The weight is on the wrong foot, the shoulder is loaded for a cut that never comes, and the counter they prepared is for a fight happening somewhere else.
abilities.description: Show a body that is about to do something else — a stance that reads as three attacks and resolves as a fourth.
abilities.notFor: Anything that does not read a body — mechanisms, wards, a foe who cannot see you; hiding, which this is not.

crit.success: They commit hard to the fight you showed them and arrive at a different one.
crit.failure: You have shown them the fight you are actually going to have.

intensity.conserve: one tell, held lightly — they may still read the rest of you
intensity.surge: a whole false body; YOU WILL FIGHT AS THE MAN YOU ARE PRETENDING TO BE

bounds.text: ⛔ THEY MUST BE READING YOU. A foe who is not looking cannot be misled
one declared false read per exchange
⚠️ a foe who has fought you before discounts it

abilities.plainly: A fight/duel action. Its strength is rated 5 out of 10.

tree.name: False Stance
tree.grants: ⛔ DECLARE THIS IN THE SENSE SLOT TO DENY THEIR READ. Your body says one thing and does another; whatever they learned about you this exchange is wrong.
tree.cannot: They must be reading you. One per exchange.

tree.name: Wrong Fight
tree.grants: ⛔ DECLARE IN THE SENSE SLOT. Your body says one thing and does another, and they ACT ON THE FALSE READ — it is wrong for the fight that happens, and they carry the penalty into it.
tree.cannot: They must commit to the false read before it costs them.
tree._grantsWas_SNG510: ⚠️ ADDS A PENALTY THEY CARRY. They do not merely fail to read you — they act on the read you gave them, and it is wrong for the fight that happens.

tree.name: Nothing True
tree.grants: ⛔ DECLARE IN THE SENSE SLOT. Every foe watching you takes a false read, and you may give different ones different fights.
tree.cannot: Everyone in sight of you. A foe who stops watching is unaffected.
tree._gainNote: ⚠️ Different foes taking different false reads is targets plus a condition, not area.
tree._grantsWas_SNG510: ⛔ ADDS TARGETS. Every foe watching you takes the false read, and you may give different ones different fights.

abilities._authored: ⛔ SNG-482. Body had NO OBSCURE — the sense slot belonged to Dark and Mind. Erik's own example: 'a stance that reads as three attacks and resolves as a fourth.'
abilities._intensityAuthored_20260829: ⚠️ WAS THE BARE STRING 'moderate' — a HARM WORD in the intensity field, from an older schema where `intensity` meant severity. ⛔ The engine reads a conserve/surge PAIR (`engine/intensity.js`), so a string meant this craft had NO conserve and NO surge and silently resolved at standard only. Authored as a real pair: conserve gives up scope for cost, surge takes something from the wielder.

abilities.name: Worth the Work
abilities.narrationHints: They name a figure. The mason looks at the job for a while, names the days and the stone and the two people it will actually take, and nobody argues.
abilities.description: Price labour, materials and time by knowing exactly what they cost — and trade work for what you need where coin will not reach.
abilities.notFor: Anything nobody needs done; work you cannot actually perform; conjuring value that is not there.

bounds.text: ⛔ YOU MUST BE ABLE TO DO THE WORK. A price you cannot deliver is a lie
they must need something done or made
⚠️ prices labour and material — it does not price a favour, a secret or a name

abilities.plainly: A social/investigate action. Its strength is rated 5 out of 10.

tree.name: Days and Stone
tree.grants: ⛔ NAME WHAT A JOB ACTUALLY COSTS in labour, material and time, and be believed. Nobody overcharges you and nobody underpays you.
tree.cannot: You must have seen the job or the thing.

tree.name: Paid in Work
tree.grants: ⛔ PAY IN WORK. Settle a debt, buy passage or secure lodging by doing the thing they need done — accepted at full value where you have no coin they want.
tree.cannot: The work must be worth what you are taking, and they must need it now.
tree._gainNote: ⛔ Work as currency is a new CONDITION you can trade under, and it opens counterparties who had no coin you wanted.
tree._grantsWas_SNG510: ⛔ ADDS WORK AS CURRENCY. Settle a debt, buy passage, or secure lodging by doing the thing they need done — accepted at full value where you have no coin they want.

tree.name: Standing Account
tree.grants: ⛔ YOUR WORD ON A PRICE IS TAKEN IN ADVANCE ACROSS A WHOLE REGION. Materials, tools, passage and hands are extended before you have paid.
tree.cannot: One region. Defaulting ends it there permanently.
tree._gainNote: ⛔ Credit extended in advance runs without you present — autonomy, and it persists.
tree._grantsWas_SNG510: ⛔ ADDS CREDIT. Your word on a price is taken in advance across a whole region — materials, tools, passage and hands are extended before you have paid.

abilities._authored: ⛔ SNG-482. Erik: every tradition bargains because there is an economy. BODY'S LEVER IS WHAT ITS LABOUR IS WORTH — and r2 makes work itself a currency, which is the mason's answer to Known Price r2.
abilities._powerSystemFix:

abilities.name: Steady Hands
abilities.narrationHints: No words. A hand on the shoulder, a grip on the wrist, weight taken. The shaking stops because someone else's body is telling theirs that it can.
abilities.description: Put hands on someone coming apart — panicking, shaking, bleeding out, about to swing — and steady them enough to act.
abilities.notFor: Anyone out of reach; grief or despair, which need more than contact; making them agree with you.

crit.success: They come back all at once, and so does everyone watching.

intensity.conserve: steady for one act, then it goes
intensity.surge: nothing shakes you at all — INCLUDING THINGS THAT SHOULD

bounds.text: ⛔ CONTACT RANGE. This is done with hands
ends fear, panic and rage — not grief, not despair

abilities.plainly: A social/survive action. Its strength is rated 5 out of 10.

tree.name: Hand On Them
tree.grants: ⛔ END FEAR, PANIC OR RAGE IN ONE PERSON YOU CAN TOUCH. The shaking stops, the breath comes back, and they can act this round.
tree.cannot: Contact range, one person, and they must permit it.

tree.name: Held Together
tree.grants: ⛔ END FEAR, PANIC OR RAGE BY TOUCH AND HOLD IT. They stay steady while you keep a hand on them — enough to be carried, stitched, talked to, or walked out.
tree.cannot: You are occupied while you hold them.
tree._grantsWas_SNG510: ⚠️ ADDS DURATION AND WORK. They stay steady while you keep a hand on them — enough to be carried, stitched, talked to, or walked out.

tree.name: Everyone Standing
tree.grants: ⛔ END FEAR, PANIC OR RAGE IN EVERYONE WITHIN ARM'S REACH AT ONCE — a stretcher line, a shield wall about to break, a crew in a storm.
tree.cannot: Arm's reach. One use per contest.
tree._gainNote: ⚠️ Everyone within arm's reach is a target count bounded by a condition.
tree._grantsWas_SNG510: ⛔ ADDS TARGETS. Steady everyone within arm's reach at once — a stretcher line, a shield wall about to break, a crew in a storm.

abilities._authored: ⛔ SNG-482. Body had no `soothe`. ⚠️ DISTINCT FROM MIND'S QUIET THE ROOM: that works at range on a room, this works by CONTACT on people you can reach, and it does not touch grief.
abilities._wardTypes:
⛔ SNG-512. By contact, and feeling only.
⚠️ `wardTypes` WAS ZERO ACROSS THE CORPUS — 26 crafts carried a `damageType` and nothing answered any of them. `answers(l)` already matches a layer to a kind; this is the missing half.
abilities._intensityAuthored_20260829: ⚠️ WAS THE BARE STRING 'moderate' — a HARM WORD in the intensity field, from an older schema where `intensity` meant severity. ⛔ The engine reads a conserve/surge PAIR (`engine/intensity.js`), so a string meant this craft had NO conserve and NO surge and silently resolved at standard only. Authored as a real pair: conserve gives up scope for cost, surge takes something from the wielder.

abilities.name: Ki Thorns
abilities.description: ⛔ SET THE BODY SO THAT HITTING IT COSTS SOMETHING. The same force a blazeborn throws and a warden draws, held just under the skin and pointed OUTWARD — a strike lands, and the striker's own momentum comes back through their arm. ⚠️ YOU DO NOTHING. That is the whole craft: it is on while you are on, and it answers whoever chose to touch you.
abilities.narrationHints: He hits her once, hard, and steps back holding his hand. ⚠️ NOTHING VISIBLE HAPPENED — no flare, no shove. The force he brought simply did not stay where he put it.
abilities.notFor: ⛔ IT ANSWERS BLOWS THAT LAND ON YOU AND NOTHING ELSE — an arrow from a roof, a working, a fire, a fall: none of those get answered, because none of them is someone's arm. ⚠️ AND IT DOES NOT PROTECT YOU: the blow lands in full and hurts exactly as much as it would have. ⛔ Nor can it be aimed, held for a moment, or spent — it is a state, not an act, and it answers your friends' clumsiness as readily as an enemy's intent.
abilities.plainly: A fight/defend action, then it runs by itself. ⛔ ANYONE WHO LANDS A MELEE BLOW ON YOU TAKES 1d6 FORCE BACK, without you spending anything. Lasts about three rounds. r2 raises it to 2d6 and staggers a striker who commits hard; r3 answers everyone in reach and holds until the fight ends. ⚠️ It does not reduce the blow you took.

intensity.conserve: half the answer, and only for a round
intensity.surge: set it as hard as you can hold; ⛔ IT ANSWERS EVERY TOUCH, INCLUDING A HAND ON YOUR SHOULDER

bounds.text: ⛔ MELEE ONLY — it answers an arm, not an arrow, a working, or a fall
⛔ IT DOES NOT SOFTEN THE BLOW. You take the strike in full; the striker simply also pays
⚠️ IT CANNOT BE AIMED OR WITHHELD — a state, not an act. It answers a friend's grab exactly as it answers an enemy's

crit.success: It comes back harder than it went in, and everyone watching decides not to be next.
crit.failure: You hold it wrong and the force stays in you — you take your own answer.

mechanic.note: guard, and ⛔ THE FIRST RETALIATION CRAFT IN THE GAME — grepped 380 crafts and nothing answers being hit. ⚠️ `reflectByDegree` (intercept.js) exists but reflects CONDITIONS on an INTERCEPTED binding; this is a PASSIVE answer to DAMAGE that lands on you, which is a different mechanism and needs its own. ⛔ `damageType: force` — PHYSICS family, the striker's own momentum returned, and the same type `ki_wield` throws outward. ⚠️ THE CRAFT COSTS NO ACTION WHILE IT RUNS, which is what makes it worth an action to set.
mechanic._notBarkAndBriar: ⚠️ CHECKED AGAINST `bark_and_briar` (rootkin), whose r1 is 'bark-skin that deflects a blow, THORNS THAT MAKE YOU COSTLY TO GRAPPLE'. ⛔ NO CONFLICT: that craft is `resist/shield/ward` and DEALS NO DAMAGE — it is protection that discourages. This one deals damage and does NOT protect. ⚠️ Same image, opposite mechanics, and the distinction is stated here so nobody merges them in a later pass.

tree.name: Set Thorns
tree.grants: ⛔ ANYONE WHO LANDS A MELEE BLOW ON YOU TAKES 1d6 FORCE BACK, and you spend nothing to answer. ⚠️ The blow still lands on you in full — this is a price on hitting you, not a defence against it.
tree.cannot: Three rounds, melee blows only, one answer per strike. ⚠️ An arrow, a working or a fall goes unanswered. ⛔ And you cannot switch it off for someone you like.

tree.name: Barbed Frame
tree.grants: ⛔ 2d6 BACK, AND A STRIKER WHO COMMITTED HARD IS STAGGERED BY THEIR OWN BLOW — the heavier the swing, the worse the answer. ⚠️ Careful fighters learn to tap at you, which is itself the point.
tree.cannot: ⛔ It still does not reduce what you take, and a patient enemy simply stops closing. ⚠️ You cannot make anyone hit you.

tree.name: Every Touch Answered
tree.grants: ⛔ EVERY HAND THAT REACHES YOU IS ANSWERED, from all sides at once, and it holds until the fighting stops rather than for a count of rounds. ⚠️ A somatic at this rank is not hard to kill — they are EXPENSIVE, and a line that has to grapple them arrives at the far side shorter than it started.
tree.cannot: ⛔ AND IT ANSWERS EVERYONE. A companion dragging you out of a fire is answered; someone catching you as you fall is answered. ⚠️ At this rank people stop touching you, and that is a cost the craft does not measure.

abilities._authored: ⛔ ERIK 2026-08-29: 'I think KI THORNS might be cool too — something that damages someone who hits you.' ⚠️ MEASURED FIRST: NOTHING IN 380 CRAFTS RETALIATES. `reflectByDegree` exists and reflects CONDITIONS on an intercepted binding (built for `shared_weight` r3); this is a PASSIVE answer to DAMAGE, which is a different mechanism. ⛔ AND IT IS THE STRONGEST ARGUMENT FOR ERIK'S RULE 8 SO FAR: I had just written that Body's missing verbs 'read as characterisation'. Body had no retaliation because nobody had thought of it, and 'ki is energy and this is a fantasy game' produced two crafts in one sitting.

_scopeRebalance: ⛔ SNG-488: scope was 18 of 81 Body gains, drifting back to the lazy default corrected in Mind (§32.4). ⚠️ In most cases scope was doing TARGETS' job — 'a group', 'a party', 'everyone in reach' are counts, not areas.
_sng510: ⛔ SNG-510: grants rewritten SELF-CONTAINED. CCode measured that `progression.abilitiesForGM` sends ONLY the rank the player holds — `tree.find(t => t.rank === owned.level)` — so a grant opening 'ADDS RANGE. Throw it' referred to an r1 the model never sees. ⚠️ STRIPPING THE OPENER WAS NOT ENOUGH: 'it' and 'the same force' had no antecedent either. Each rank now names its own craft, its own effect and its own numbers.
_sng523:
⛔ SNG-523: `mechanic.crit` authored. ⚠️ `critFor` HAS EXISTED, WITH A PER-CRAFT CAP AND A STRING SHORTHAND FOR AUTHORS, AND HAS NEVER HAD AN INPUT — 0 of 373. Every critical in the game was generic.
⛔ BOTH HALVES AUTHORED: `success` is what the craft's best case LOOKS LIKE; `failure` is its disaster. ⚠️ MOST CARRY TEXT ONLY — `chance` is opt-in and shifts nothing unless asked for, so a craft can say what its disaster looks like without claiming it happens more often.
